acceptance: Pending heads are retried within a stated bound (for example 90 minutes) without relying on GitHub's cron cadence, measured over at least 3 days.
The retry trigger keeps the existing daily budget, backoff and attempt limits.
description: `.github/workflows/oracle-verdict.yml` schedules its retry sweep with cron `23 * * * *` (`:16-17`). GitHub started 65 scheduled runs between 2026-10-10 and 2026-10-22, between 3 and 7 a day instead of 24 (Actions API, `event=schedule`). A head whose run ends pending (every reviewer absent, or waiting on backoff) depends on that sweep. In the 2026-10-21 investigation of 450 recorded attempts, heads with an absence that later got a verdict waited 0.2 to 8.8 hours. The same-reviewer retry inside the run (oracle-response-absence-retry-20261021) removes part of that dependence; a run that still ends pending waits for the sweep. Options not yet chosen: a delayed dispatch from the run that ends pending, or a scheduler outside GitHub.
